lines: Celio: Hi! I'm Celio, Bill's friend. I'm building the Network Machine.
It will link Kanto's PCs with faraway regions, so trainers can trade with Johto!
But it needs two special gems, a Ruby and a Sapphire, to power it.
People say Team Rocket has been sneaking around these islands looking for gems...
If you find out anything, please come back and tell me!
done: Celio: Still no Ruby or Sapphire... I heard Team Rocket was seen on Mt. Ember.

fail: Celio: The farther islands are only open to Champions with a National Pokedex.
lines: Celio: You're the Champion, and you have the National Pokedex!
Take this Rainbow Pass. The Seagallop Ferry will take you to Islands 4 through 7.
Maybe out there you'll find where Team Rocket hid the gems!
Celio: The Ruby AND the Sapphire! You got them back from Team Rocket!
With these, the Network Machine works! Kanto is linked to the world.
Oh, and the warehouse files mentioned this old sea chart...
It shows an island that isn't on any map. Sailors see a pink Pokemon there!

lines: You dig around the washed-up driftwood...
Something shiny was buried in the sand!
Researcher: We're studying the volcano's heat... but two men in black chased us off!
They were digging near the summit, talking about a gem called the Ruby.
Rocket Grunt: The boss is gone, but we've got our own plans now!
Gems, stronger Pokemon, forced evolution... Scram, kid!

player_won: Grunt: Fine, keep the mountain! We'll find the gems elsewhere.

lines: Man: My daughter Lostelle went to pick berries on Three Island and never came home!
Bikers have taken over the bridge there... Please, help me find her!
done: Man: Lostelle went to the Berry Forest past Bond Bridge on Three Island!

lines: Lostelle: Thank you for saving me from that Hypno!
Dad: How can we ever repay you? Please, take these.

Biker: This island's ours now! Nobody crosses Bond Bridge without beating our leader!

player_won: Paxton: Okay, okay! We're leaving! Take your bridge back!

boss.name: Hypno
lines: Deep in the misty forest, a Hypno is swinging its pendulum at a crying girl!
won: The Hypno runs off into the mist.
Lostelle: You saved me! I want to go home to Two Island!

lines: Lorelei: This is my home island. I came back to rest after the League...
But Team Rocket is in Icefall Cave, catching Lapras to sell! Please stop them.
done: Lorelei: Thank you for saving the Icefall Cave Pokemon.

lines: Lorelei: You saved the Lapras. Now, a battle, just for fun. Don't hold back!

player_won: Lorelei: Still as strong as ever. Come back any time.

done: Lorelei: That was a wonderful battle.

lines: Old Man: I raise Pokemon by the water... This Egg hatched while I wasn't looking!
Togepi needs a trainer who travels. Will you take it?
You feel your way through the pitch-black cave...
Someone dropped a pouch here long ago. You found it!
The doors open, one by one. The Admin's office is ahead!
puzzle_fail: The door pads reset. Try the codes again!

lines: Admin: So you're the one ruining our plans on every island.
With the Ruby and Sapphire we'd force any Pokemon to evolve! Prepare yourself!

player_won: Archer: Impossible... Take your precious gems, then!

lines: On the Admin's desk sit two glowing gems: the Ruby and the Sapphire!
Team Rocket's Sevii hideout is shut down for good. Take them to Celio!
Ruin Maniac: There's a sealed cave in Ruin Valley called the Dotted Hole.
Its walls are covered in raised dots. Count them right and the door opens!

As you reach for it, a man in a lab coat shoves past and grabs it!
Gideon: Thanks for opening the door! Team Rocket will pay well for this.
He runs off toward the docks... toward Five Island's Rocket Warehouse!

intro: Floor 1! Can you climb the whole Tower?
The top floor! I am the Tower Master. Show me your best!
player_won: You've conquered the Trainer Tower! Climb again any time.
player_lost: The Tower stands. Come back and try again!

lines: Unown of every shape swirl out of the seven chambers!
Tall grass sways on the uncharted island. Something pink giggles and darts away...
It only shows itself to a trainer who has caught all 150 other Kanto Pokemon.
Your Pokedex: {kanto_caught} of the 150 Kanto Pokemon. {kanto_missing} still to catch!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Sevii Islands
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Blaine's Tri-Pass opens the Seagallop Ferry from Vermilion. Meet Celio on One Island.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Team Rocket on Mt. Ember
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Researchers on Mt. Ember saw Team Rocket digging for a gem. Chase them off, and look for Moltres at the summit.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lost Lostelle
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Lostelle never came home from Three Island. Beat the bikers on Bond Bridge and search the Berry Forest.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Rainbow Pass
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: As Champion with the National Pokedex, ask Celio for the Rainbow Pass to Islands 4-7.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ruby and the Sapphire
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Stop Team Rocket in Icefall Cave, open the Dotted Hole on Six Island, then raid the Rocket Warehouse on Five Island.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Faraway Island
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Celio's old sea map shows an uncharted island. A pink Pokemon lives there...
